mapper.insert: insert into order_review (order_id, user_id, coach_id, course_id, coach_rating, course_rating, content, images, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{coachId}, #{courseId}, #{coachRating}, #{courseRating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select r.*, c.name as course_name, co.name as coach_name from order_review r left join course c on r.course_id = c.id left join coach co on r.coach_id = co.id where r.order_id = #{orderId}
